assets.title: Атлас Небесных Островов
assets.prompt:
Generate one image and save it as cover.png in the current directory.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: full-page campaign cover, landscape 3:2 (1536 by 1024). Subject: the start of a great air regatta through an archipelago of floating stone islands above a bright ocean of clouds. Eight small racing sail-gliders with differently coloured sails surge away from a cliffside harbour of wooden piers and starting cables; one cream-and-coral glider in the foreground banks hard as a sudden gust snaps a white start ribbon free; on the pier behind, a large slate board chalked with columns of times and a bronze starting bell. In the far distance a colossal natural ring of rock shaped like a crown floats on the horizon, and an island hangs at a tilt with waterfalls falling sideways along a natural seam of the wind. Pilots are small but readable, leaning into the wind.

Match one consistent house style: original premium illustrated adventure fantasy for teenagers and adults, painterly gouache and ink with confident visible brushwork, crisp readable silhouettes and subtle paper grain, airy cinematic composition with strong sense of height, wind and motion; palette of luminous sky azure and cerulean, cloud white and pale gold sunlight, sail cream, signal coral red, chalk white and warm brass, with deep slate-blue shadows. Wonder, competitive excitement and warm humanity; no horror, no franchise references, no anime look, no photorealism. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border.
